SELECT AL.*, C.CustName, Comp.CompName, B.BranchName, D.DeptName, Dt.DutyName FROM shopion.tPrfCustApprovLine AL INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfCust C ON C.CustId = AL.ApprovCustId INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfComp Comp ON C.CompCode = Comp.CompCode INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfBranch B ON C.BranchId = B.BranchId INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfDept D ON C.BranchId = D.BranchId AND C.DeptCode = D.DeptCode INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfDuty Dt ON C.DutyId = Dt.DutyId
AND AL.CustId = #{pCustId} AND AL.ApprovLevel = #{pApprovLevel}
